title: 법률구조법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 9 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Justice shall, every 2 years (referring to the date preceding the date of the year in which 2 years have passed), review the validity of the following items based on the dates specified below, and take appropriate measures such as improvements:

1. Application for registration as a Legal Structure Law company, as defined in Article 2, along with accompanying documents: January 1, 2015
2. Procedure for changing the registration of a Legal Structure Law company, as defined in Article 4: January 1, 2015
